Bettina, I can't set up this recurring digest. I don't have a scheduling tool here, so nothing will post automatically on Monday at 08:00.

What I can do:

- **Post the digest by hand.** Ask me in #coastal-team on any Monday and I'll post a "Coastal week ahead" covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both channels have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so combining them won't expose anything to people who can't already see it.
- **Set up the schedule elsewhere.** Someone with access to the scheduler (an admin or the platform team) would need to create the Monday 08:00 job. I can write the digest text for them to use.

Before the first digest, tell me where the "open customer items" live (a folder, a ticket queue, or a specific channel), because I don't know which source you mean.
